opinions.text:

Decree affirmed. Dohany v. Rogers, 281 U. S. 362, 366; Bragg v. Weaver, 251 U. S. 57, 62; Sweet v. Rechel, 159 U. S. 380, 402; Backus v. Fort Street Union Depot Co., 169 U. S. 557, 568.
